messages:
emma: heads up monitoring fired - apiserver 503 spike across a subset of controlplane nodes in us-west1, started ~10:08 UTC :rotating_light:
sre-bot: ALERT: apiserver_errors_5xx > threshold (us-west1 controlplane group). see https://ops.redwood/alerts/8231
raj: seeing etcd leader changes at the same time, leader moved twice in ~90s. logs show election timeouts.
kevin: any packet loss? i've got a couple of l7 LB healthcheck failures but not full region outage.
lia: checked k8s events, controller-manager is requeuing a lot of nodes: "error retrieving resource: client.Get \"/api/v1/nodes\": net/http: timeout"
emma: pasted leader flip snippet:
```
2024-11-04T10:08:12Z etcd1 etcdserver: detected leader change, term 45 -> 46
2024-11-04T10:09:45Z etcd2 etcdserver: election triggered, timed out waiting for votes
```
raj: ran `etcdctl member list` - one member reporting raft state: follower, slow_recv. suspect disk i/o spikes on etcd3.
kevin: also noticed GPU provisioning queue is piling up - a few inference pods Pending with events: "FailedScheduling: 0/6 nodes available: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu" but that's likely downstream from controller-manager thrash.
lia: network team, can we get packet drop / interface error stats for the controlplane subnet? could be flapping NICs causing intermittent RPC timeouts. @kevin
kevin: on it, grabbing interfaces now. seeing RX errors on eth2 on controlplane-3 in us-west1-b. RX errors correlate with the leader flips.
oncall: recommendation: scale apiserver replicas from 3 -> 5 temporarily, and move etcd follower off the noisy host. can we cordon controlplane-3 and migrate etcd pod?
emma: agreed. plan: (1) bump apiserver replicas, (2) safely demote etcd on controlplane-3 and remove member, let it rejoin on better host, (3) adjust LB healthcheck to 15s grace to avoid flapping.
raj: note: demoting/removing etcd member will trigger election - do during quiet window and ensure quorum remains (we're 3-member). prefer adding a short extra member first but we don't have spare host with low latency.
lia: quick mitigation executed: scaled apiserver -> 5 (now stable on metric graphs), cordoned controlplane-3, started etcd pod reschedule.
kevin: network team replaced NIC on controlplane-3 (confirmed hardware error). post-replace RX errors cleared.
emma: after reschedule, etcd stabilized, leader elected once, controller-manager backlog drained. GPU pod Pending count decreased as schedulers processed backlog.
oncall: follow-ups: open ticket to add monitoring for NIC error rates to controlplane dashboards, consider warm spare for etcd quorum (cost impact), evaluate increasing etcd election timeout from 1s -> 2s for noisy links.
raj: +1 on monitoring. regarding cost, adding a fourth etcd node increases infra bill; we should model 3 vs 5 controlplane nodes vs dedicated etcd runners.
kevin: i'll draft cost/latency tradeoff spreadsheet. initial prioritize reliability for prod regions (us-west1, eu-west1).
lia: closing status: incident resolved, apiserver 5xx returned to baseline ~10:28 UTC. will file postmortem with timeline and action items. :white_check_mark:
